title: Annual Fee a TRICARE Select Card-Paid Installment Is Figured From
content:
For a one-time card payment on a fee-bearing **TRICARE Select** enrollment, the annual fee a card-paid installment is figured from follows the enrollment's fee arrangement and, for an individual arrangement, the enrollee's catastrophic standing.

**Clause.** Where the enrollment's fee arrangement is individual, so that exactly one family member is enrolled in Select and the family's catastrophic total is that member's own, and that total for the plan year has reached the tier's family catastrophic cap, enrollment fees are no longer collected for the rest of the plan year and the annual fee a card-paid installment is figured from is zero; that total is the beneficiary liability posted on the enrollment's Select claim lines less the liability their reversals withdrew, plus, where the tier's enrollment fees count toward the catastrophic cap, the enrollment fees paid toward installments whose coverage period has begun (the payments posted, never more than those installments). Where the fee arrangement is individual and that total falls short of the cap, the annual fee is the tier's individual annual fee; otherwise, with two or more members enrolled under a family arrangement, it is the tier's family annual fee.

An installment's coverage period has begun when it starts on or before the payment date. The fee arrangement (individual or family) is the one shown on the enrollment.

## Condition - judgement - result

| Fee arrangement | Catastrophic total for the plan year | Annual fee |
|---|---|---|
| individual (exactly one member enrolled) | equal to or above the tier's cap | 0.00 |
| individual | below the cap | the tier's individual annual fee |
| family (two or more members enrolled) | not tested | the tier's family annual fee |

## Figures by tier (US dollars per calendar plan year)

| Tier | Family catastrophic cap | Fees count toward the cap | Individual annual fee | Family annual fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-1 to E-4) | 1000.00 | no | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-5 and Above) | 1000.00 | no | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group B (E-1 to E-4) | 1252.00 | no | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group B (E-5 and Above) | 1252.00 | no | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| TRICARE Select Retiree Group A | 3000.00 | yes | 198.00 | 396.00 |
| TRICARE Select Retiree Group B | 4034.00 | yes | 595.08 | 1190.16 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, TRICARE Select Retiree Group A, cap 3000.00, installments begun 198.00)

| Arrangement | Liability posted net of reversals | Fee payments posted | Fees counted | Total | Annual fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| individual | 2802.00 | 198.00 | 198.00 | 3000.00 | 0.00 |
| individual | 2801.99 | 198.00 | 198.00 | 2999.99 | 198.00 |
| individual | 2801.99 | 396.00 | 198.00 (never more than the begun installments) | 2999.99 | 198.00 |
| family | 3500.00 | 396.00 | - | not tested | 396.00 |
